verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents a first-party MCP server and CLI explicitly designed so AI agents can perform nearly any workspace action (build automations, drafts, segments, analysis) via natural-language prompts, plus a Slack-based AI agent for conversational operation. This is well corroborated across multiple docs pages, though independent hands-on verification of the natural-language experience is absent. Missing for 10: independent/community confirmation that natural-language commands work reliably in practice, and more detail on limits of natural-language coverage vs. UI-only features.
